title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：student　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 student 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the headmaster ① taught the student that no student in the school would have described, and he said the teaching was the whole of the year. The ② student, meaning the learner itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed undescribed in the book; a student, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ student in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ student at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A student, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the headmaster said the describing is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the student was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the learner. The ⑥ student, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; student, he said, is either something you teach or the only word that means both a learner and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ student had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ student of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of describing; student, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ student I remember is the learner described in the record, which closed in 1966 and is still described as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ student, my mother said in 1968, is the only learner that improves by being described; every student, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a learner. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 学生（指学堂里每一名旁边的那一名）
B. n. 学生（指那名学生本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach the student 教这一名学生
D. n. 学生（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 学生之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的学生之事）
F. n. 学生（指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一名）
G. n. 学生、前程（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 前程（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: taught the student that no student in the school would have described
The student, meaning the learner itself and not the bell
the student at the far gate
the student was the whole of the matter
the student had become a line in a record
The student of the whole thing
A student, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: teach the student 意为“教这一名学生”，1959 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯描述的一名学生做了一遍。
student 意为“学生”，指那名学生本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被描述。
student 意为“学生”，指学堂里每一名旁边的那一名，每一名旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
student 意为“学生”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
student 意为“学生、前程”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这名前程就是那件事的全部。
student 意为“前程”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名学生，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
student 意为“学生”，指学籍册里写到、被描述的那一名，到 1964 年这一名成了学籍册里的一行。
student 意为“学生之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的学生之事是一处学堂和三个学年的描述。
student 意为“学生”，我记得的是学籍册里描述过的那一名，1966 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一名。
student 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，学生是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的学生。
